job.job_description:
Role Overview
We are seeking a seasoned .NET Development Leader with a strong background in designing scalable enterprise solutions and leading engineering teams. The candidate will drive architecture, guide development teams, and deliver high-quality, cloud-native applications aligned with business objectives.
Experience
10 to 15 years of overall experience in software development
At least 35 years in a Lead/Architect role managing teams and driving technical decisions
Required Technical Skills
Strong expertise in:
.NET Core / ASP.NET Core
Microservices Architecture REST APIs
Frontend: React and/or Angular
Experience with:
Cloud platforms: Azure and/or GCP
AI/ML integration (LLM APIs, intelligent workflows, or data-driven systems)
GenAI / LLM-based solutions
Containerization (Docker, Kubernetes)
Strong knowledge of:
C#, OOPs, Design Patterns, Clean Architecture
Distributed systems and scalable application design
Database technologies (SQL/NoSQL)
Good to Have
Experience with Python (especially for ML/AI pipelines)
Exposure to AWS cloud services
Key Responsibilities
Lead end-to-end solution architecture and design for enterprise applications
Drive development using modern engineering practices (CI/CD, TDD, DevOps)
Design and implement scalable microservices-based systems
Collaborate with product, QA, and cross-functional teams for delivery excellence
Mentor and guide developers; enforce coding standards and best practices
Ensure high-quality deliverables with focus on performance, security, and reliability
Drive cloud adoption and modernization initiatives
Troubleshoot complex production issues and provide architectural solutions
Engineering Process Expectations
Strong exposure to:
Agile methodologies (Scrum/Kanban)
CI/CD pipelines, DevOps practices
Automated testing (TDD/BDD)
Focus on:
Code quality, maintainability, and performance optimization
Observability (logging, monitoring, tracing)
Leadership Soft Skills
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills
Strong problem-solving and decision-making ability
Ability to translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions
Proven track record of team leadership and mentoring
Preferred Background
Experience in enterprise SaaS platforms
Exposure to healthcare/RCM domain
Experience with high-volume transaction systems
